args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back**: All regions rolled back to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Verified post-rollback: service is healthy with error rate down to ~0.2%.
3. **Opened incident**: INC-0001 (SEV2) — paged on-call, documenting the failure of v2.3.1, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the verification results.

Note: v2.3.1 (and its staging rc) remain unhealthy — it will need root-cause investigation before any redeploy attempt, and per policy, future deploys of an untested version would require change-manager approval anyway.
